command: set -euo pipefail; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; id -un; date -Is; test "$(id -un)" = andreas; cd /home/andreas/self-integration; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 5b06f6c40eefb9b2bb058c8117f8705cdff50a6a; SRC=werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh; CONF=werkzeug/entityos-vm-volatile-state-guard.conf; test "$(sha256sum "$SRC" | awk '{print $1}')" = 794066b1b4caa6b2ae6ec5098aa019f2c13dbce234d7bb5ec31820273c5946b0; test "$(sha256sum "$CONF" | awk '{print $1}')" = 8750f098ff8e5a7aaca53b981d58e6fc446ebd64c617f7d9b2b990242b6adc8e; ACTIVE_BEFORE=$(systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service); PID_BEFORE=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value); echo ACTIVE_BEFORE=$ACTIVE_BEFORE PID_BEFORE=$PID_BEFORE; test "$ACTIVE_BEFORE" = active; sudo -n install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec/entityos /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d; sudo -n install -m 0755 "$SRC" /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh; sudo -n install -m 0644 "$CONF" /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf; sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload; echo '===READBACK==='; sha256sum /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p DropInPaths --no-pager; systemctl cat entityos-vm.service --no-pager | tail -40; ACTIVE_AFTER=$(systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service); PID_AFTER=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value); test "$ACTIVE_AFTER" = active; test "$PID_AFTER" = "$PID_BEFORE"; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p DropInPaths --value | grep -Fq '/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf'; set +e; /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh >/tmp/omega-guard.out 2>/tmp/omega-guard.err; GRC=$?; set -e; echo GUARD_RC=$GRC; tail -20 /tmp/omega-guard.out /tmp/omega-guard.err 2>/dev/null || true; test "$GRC" -eq 255; echo 'OMEGA_INTERLOCK_INSTALLED_AND_EFFECTIVE=1'; echo 'VM_LIFECYCLE_MUTATION=0'
